# Maine Roofing Scapes & Repairs

> Professional Commercial & Residential Roofing Contractor Serving Maine and New Hampshire Since 2021.

## Entity & Verified Business Information
- **Company Name**: Maine Roofing Scapes & Repairs
- **Phone**: +1 (207) 383-1646
- **Service Area**: State of Maine, State of New Hampshire, and select commercial roofing restoration projects across New England (ME, NH, MA, VT, RI).
- **Founded**: 2021
- **Business Type**: Service Area Business (Roofing Contractor, Commercial Roofing, Roof Restoration)
- **Primary Website**: https://maineroofingscapesrepairs.com

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Commercial Roof Restoration**: Fluid-applied elastomeric and silicone roof coating systems extending flat roof lifespans by 15-20 years without complete tear-off. Proven experience on large hospitality and commercial properties including the DoubleTree by Hilton complex.
- **Commercial Flat Roofing**: Certified installations and repairs of TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen roofing systems engineered for extreme snow loads and freeze-thaw cycles.
- **Residential Roof Replacement**: Heavy-duty architectural asphalt shingle installations with high wind ratings (up to 130 mph) and multi-layer ice and water shield protection.
- **Standing Seam Metal Roofing**: Lifetime concealed-fastener metal roofs designed to shed heavy Maine snow and eliminate ice dams permanently.
- **Emergency Roof Repair**: Rapid diagnostic and dispatch service for missing shingles, chimney flashing leaks, tree damage, and wind damage.
- **Winter Ice Dam Removal & Roof Snow Clearing**: Low-pressure safe steam ice dam removal, snow load mitigation, snow guards, and self-regulating heating cables.

## Critical Business Scope Clarification
- Maine Roofing Scapes & Repairs specializes strictly in **roofing and roof-related systems**.
- The company **does NOT install or service gutters or siding**.

## Notable Projects
- **DoubleTree by Hilton**: Multi-tiered commercial flat roof restoration featuring seamless elastomeric coatings and reinforced perimeter flashings.
- **Maine Coastal Residential Restorations**: Standing seam metal roofing and architectural shingle installations engineered for coastal nor'easters.
